title: Community Safety Plan: Intensive On-Country program to begin in Mount Isa
recipient_organization: Mithangkaya Nguli – Young People Ahead Youth and Community Services Indigenous Corporation
description: First tender awarded for Intensive On Country youth justice trial in Mount Isa region. Program focuses on intensive cultural and residential experiences, family supports, education and training opportunities and connection to employment for young people with youth justice system engagement.

title: New co-responder team tackling youth crime in Mount Isa
recipient_organization: Five locations statewide (Mount Isa, Toowoomba, Fraser Coast, South Brisbane, Ipswich)
description: New youth co-responder teams comprised of police and youth justice workers who patrol together and engage with young people and their families to deter offending. Part of $100M investment in programs that tackle complex causes of crime.

title: More funding for Mount Isa's Stronger Communities approach
minister: Premier Annastacia Palaszczuk, Minister Di Farmer
recipient_organization: Mount Isa community (led by Alan Baillie)
description: Expanded service delivery and additional funding for Mount Isa. Local leader Alan Baillie to head up collaborative, community-led approach ensuring services and initiatives address complex issues behind young offending.

title: Record youth justice budget puts community safety first
description: Record $396.5M total budget for Department of Youth Justice (2023-24). Includes $189.5M over 5 years for intervention and diversionary programs including Youth Co-responder Teams, Intensive Case Management, Specialist Youth Crime Rapid Response Squad and On Country programs.

title: Miles Labor Government delivers record Police and Community Safety budget
description: Record $4.379 billion allocation for Police and Community Safety, underpinning Queensland's historic Community Safety Plan. Provides extra officers and staff, more resources and enhanced equipment.

title: Youth Co-Responder Teams contributing to reduced offending
description: $11.2M investment to increase capacity of Youth Co-Responder Teams, delivering additional vehicles to hot spots (Cairns, Gold Coast) and new teams (Sunshine Coast, South West district).
outcomes: 73% reduction in serious repeat offender reoffending. Average offences dropped from 25 to 7 in 6 months post-engagement. 14% reduction in serious repeat offenders who re-offend since Oct 2023.

title: Community grants help tackle youth offending in Mount Isa and Townsville
description: Two Mount Isa projects among 12 receiving grants (total $3M+). Queensland Youth Services: $130K for 'Proud Warrior' project (intervention for Indigenous young people at risk). 54 Reasons: $300K for 'Back to Community' reintegration program (culturally responsive support for young people from Mount Isa, Doomadgee, Mornington Island leaving Cleveland Youth Detention Centre).

title: New funding to tackle youth crime in Mount Isa
description: $200,000 for Mount Isa Community Connect Project (established April 2019). $2.25M over 3 years to trial new 'On Country' program in Mount Isa. Community Connect enables community members and local representatives from government agencies to work together on community-based solutions.
